breaking: table is rendered by the server component; a client controller sorts, searches and pages the existing rows
removed controlled sorting / selectedIds / page / pageSize props, defaultPage, defaultPageSize, onPageSizeChange, sortFn, filter and filterFn
pageSize now enables pagination (was the controlled value); sortValue replaces sortFn; searchable adds a built-in search over row text
onSelectionChange gets ids only (no rows) and works only when rendered from a client component
new props selectName, toolbar, noMatchState, labels; toolbar hooks data-selection-only, data-selected-count, data-table-clear-selection

how.en: Server-rendered table; a client controller moves rows to sort and flips data attributes to search and page. Selection is native checkboxes, highlighted by :has(:checked) and submitted with a form
how.ru: Таблица рендерится на сервере; клиентский контроллер переставляет строки для сортировки и меняет data-атрибуты для поиска и страниц. Выбор — нативные чекбоксы, подсветка через :has(:checked), отправка с формой
